stories.title: Signalling fault disrupts Hong Kong high-speed rail service, delaying 15 trains
stories.summary: At least 15 high-speed cross-border train services were delayed after a signalling fault prompted a 45-minute disruption of northbound services in Hong Kong on Sunday morning. The Transport Department said at around 8.30am that the MTR Corporation had notified authorities that high-speed rail services would be delayed due to a “signal fault”. stories.headline: Signalling fault disrupts Hong Kong high-speed rail service, delaying 15 trains

opening: At least 15 high-speed cross-border train services were delayed after a signalling fault prompted a 45-minute disruption of northbound services in Hong Kong on Sunday morning.
The Transport Department said at around 8.30am that the MTR Corporation had notified authorities that high-speed rail services would be delayed due to a “signal fault”.
body: At around 9.15am, the department said the MTR had resolved the signal issues, and high-speed rail services were gradually resuming normally.

sentences.text: At least 15 high-speed cross-border train services were delayed after a signalling fault prompted a 45-minute disruption of northbound services in Hong Kong on Sunday morning.
The Transport Department said at around 8.30am that the MTR Corporation had notified authorities that high-speed rail services would be delayed due to a “signal fault”.
At around 9.15am, the department said the MTR had resolved the signal issues, and high-speed rail services were gradually resuming normally.
